headline: Khaitan acts on HFCL ₹555 cr preferential issue of warrants
sum: HFCL is issuing 7.5 cr warrants worth ₹555 cr to its promoter group - a preferential capital raise.
detail: HFCL Limited is making a preferential issue of 7,50,00,000 warrants aggregating to ₹555 crore to the Promoter and Promoter Group. Khaitan & Co advised HFCL. HFCL is a technology company specialising in telecom equipment, fibre-optic cables and defence solutions.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “HFCL Limited is set to make a preferential issue of 7,50,00,000 warrants aggregating to ₹555 crore to the Promoter and Promoter Group.” - confirms Khaitan and the Bassi/Mittal team.
